_help: Currencies and payment methods for the Payment page. Fill in every empty "value". Rows with an empty value are hidden. type "transfer" = payment confirmation form, type "appointment" = visit request form. Set "enabled": false to hide a method.

methods.name: Bank Transfer
methods.intro: Transfer the order total to the bank account below.

poster.alt: Bank transfer details for OMR payments

steps: Copy the account details above.
Transfer the exact order total in OMR from your bank app.
Write your order ID in the transfer note.
Fill in the form below and send it.

methods.name: Send Money
methods.intro: Send the order total with a money transfer service.

poster.alt: Send money details for OMR payments

steps: Open your money transfer app or visit an exchange.
Send the exact order total in OMR to the receiver above.
Keep the transaction number.
Fill in the form below and send it.

methods.name: Face to Face
methods.intro: Meet in person and pay in cash. Choose a date and time and we will confirm it.
steps: Choose a date and time that suits you.
Send the form. We will confirm on WhatsApp.
Bring the exact amount in OMR to the meeting.

methods.name: PayPal
methods.intro: Pay the order total in USD with PayPal.
steps: Open PayPal with the button above, or send money to the PayPal email.
Pay the exact order total in USD.
Write your order ID in the PayPal note.
Fill in the form below and send it.

methods.name: RedotPay
methods.intro: Pay the order total in USD with RedotPay.
steps: Open RedotPay with the button above, or send to the RedotPay ID.
Pay the exact order total in USD.
Write your order ID in the note.
Fill in the form below and send it.

methods.name: Bank Transfer
methods.intro: Transfer the order total to the Bangladeshi bank account below.

poster.alt: Bank transfer details for BDT payments

steps: Copy the account details above.
Transfer the exact order total in BDT.
Write your order ID in the transfer note.
Fill in the form below and send it.

methods.name: Send Money
methods.intro: Send the order total with mobile banking.

poster.alt: Send money details for BDT payments

steps: Open your mobile banking app and choose Send Money.
Send the exact order total in BDT to the number above.
Keep the transaction ID.
Fill in the form below and send it.
